hooks.text: Early spacewalking was so exhausting it nearly killed astronauts.
How did an astronaut conquer deadly spacewalk exhaustion?
Spacewalks were nearly impossible until astronauts practiced underwater.

title: How Gemini 12 Solved Spacewalk Exhaustion
description: Discover how Buzz Aldrin conquered deadly space fatigue on Gemini 12 by introducing underwater pool training.
